title: Networking Fundamentals
tagline: Understand the protocols that every attacker exploits and every defender must master
description: Every attack travels over a network. This course builds your deep understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, TLS, and network analysis with Wireshark. You'll understand what happens at the packet level when you visit a website, conduct a port scan, or intercept traffic.
learningObjectives: Explain the OSI model and which attacks occur at each layer
Trace a DNS resolution from start to finish
Understand TLS handshakes and what can go wrong
Identify network anomalies in packet captures
author: Cyber Learn Team
